notes.title: 【Fixes】Behavior Adjustments and Bat Swing Speed Tweaks
notes.content:
The following fixes have been made:

・Enhanced the favor ball effect under Authority, increasing both its size and power boost.
・In Stage9, fixed the behavior so that fireballs are no longer thrown after the first two shots.
・Increased the maximum swing speed of the bat.
・Adjusted power scaling related to bat swing speed.
・Fixed the default value of Mouse Sensitivity (Horizontal).

●About bat swing speed – existing mechanics:
Although it may seem like faster swings result in longer hits, in reality, power scaling stops increasing beyond a certain swing speed.
Due to hidden effects such as those from Arm Guard-type items and I am CEO, the swing speed requirement is loosened, allowing you to achieve maximum power scaling even with relatively slower swings.

●About bat swing speed – new mechanics in this update:
・The power reduction when spinning like a top has been slightly increased.
・Power scaling for slower swing speeds has been improved.

---

Thanks to these changes, increased swing speed will provide noticeable benefits up to Stage9, but the effect will be minimal from Stage10 onward.
The update is intended to let you better tailor the feel, timing, and precision of your swings to your own preferences.

notes.title: 【Major Update】He’s back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540477/c24265eab5290141fc62a9386c9aa426319b3857.png[/img]
The final battle begins now…!
Major Update “Return of KUSOGAKI” is live!

Various elements have been adjusted for a smoother experience.
Challenging stages await in the latter half of the game.
Can you conquer them all?
And who—or what—is the returning KUSOGAKI?

[h2]Additions & Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Core behavior and display adjustments
[*]New stages added from Stage 9 onward (use waist shift to go up)
[*]New achievements
[*]New Challenge Mode
[*]Balance changes to existing stages
[/list]

[h2]Note[/h2]
Take a break if you're tired.

[h2]For players who played before the update[/h2]
Overall, the difficulty of earlier stages has been lowered.
[list]
[*]Stage 6 (Squid) has new behavior. Stage 8 has also been adjusted. Some goal points in other stages were modified as well.
[*]The base power of the bat should be stronger than before.
[*]Tutorial content has been added to Stages 1–3.
If you're not sure how to hit the ball far, Stage 3's tutorial covers the key info.
Mash Restart to begin the tutorial.
[/list]

We’ve also prepared a small celebration for those who clear the new hard stages for the first time.
If you beat Stage [strike]EX2[/strike] or Stage KUSO, let us know—
and send proof via video!

notes.title: Most Dangerous Update
notes.content:
We’ve made several updates focused on reducing the graphic load.
If your system is struggling to run the game, please give these a try.
And if it’s still heavy, feel free to let us know.

・Implemented Performance Saver
　From the title screen, go to Performance Saver and select Lightweight Version.
　This simplifies particularly heavy effects, such as explosions.

・Added Prettier Screen setting
　This can be adjusted from the in-game menu.
　It lets you fine-tune additive blending effects.
　If the visuals are too bright or you want better performance, try setting it to 0.

・Increased the bat’s hitbox size for mighty boss

・Adjusted Rank Requirements (Pitches) for Stage 3

・Slightly eased power scaling up to 1st Cosmic Velocity

notes.title: Update Big Nice
notes.content:
We’ve made several adjustments, mainly around the Mouse Boost feature.
This should improve compatibility with a wider range of mice.
If you still feel something’s off, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Fixed Mouse Sensitivity settings in the menu screen.
Sensitivity is now split into Mouse Sensitivity (Vertical) and Mouse Sensitivity (Horizontal).

Further relaxed the activation conditions for the Secret Technique “Maximum Burning” when using Mouse Boost.
If you’re still having trouble activating it, try moving your mouse slowly upward.
Some non-gaming mice may fail to register extremely fast movements.

Buffed the Mouse Boost mode so that you can now fight alongside the legendary swan.

notes.title: How To Flail
notes.content:
Here are some tips for playing.
Yeah… we really didn’t explain anything. Sorry about that.
Hope this helps!

[b]〇Open the Menu[/b]
Please, for the love of god, open it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
We’re sorry about the poor guidance and lack of explanation!!!
There’s some genuinely useful stuff written in there!!
Like settings that’ll make your movements smoother and other useful things!!

[b]〇Aim for Supersonic[/b]
To score high, only four things matter:
Three rules, and how fast you move your mouse.

Swing the bat all at once while it's glowing red.

The best hits usually happen when the bat has rotated exactly 180 degrees from the start of your swing.

There’s a sweet spot on the bat — the closer the ball hits to it, the better it flies.
The sweet spot is somewhere between the center and the tip of the bat.
If you hit it just right, you’ll see sparks and hear a metallic sound.
Use the Contact setting to fine-tune your hits.

[b]〇Use the Secret Technique[/b]
From Stage 6 onwards, using the Secret Technique at the right time is the key.
Hit easy balls yourself, and let the Secret Technique handle the impossible ones.
Or go for high scores by using it even on the easy balls. Your call.

[b]〇Check Your Mouse Speed[/b]
The game is more or less designed with high-sensitivity mice in mind.
We built it assuming your batter would rotate about 3/4 of the way around with one arm swing.

If you only have a low-sensitivity mouse and can’t get the bat to swing properly,
go to the title screen and open Mouse Boost Settings.
Just keep in mind — it’ll feel like a totally different game.
Also, we don’t really recommend spinning around like a helicopter in Mouse Boost mode.
(It doesn’t hit very well, at least not programmatically.)

[b]〇Give Up After 30 Minutes[/b]
Just boot it up once in a while and shout “What a garbage game!”
That’s the proper way to play.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
We’ve made the following adjustments as a quick fix:

・Increased vertical speed in Mouse Boost Settings

We’re planning an upcoming update that will allow fine-tuning of mouse aim speed for vertical movement only.
If you encounter any other issues or have feedback, feel free to let us know.

Until then, happy arm-swinging!

notes.content:
It seems there’s been an issue with the release process, and we’re currently in contact with support.
Given the timing and business hours, it looks unlikely that we’ll be able to release as originally scheduled.

That said, everything on our end is fully prepared—we’ll proceed with the release as soon as these issues are resolved.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: March 27, 2028(PDT) On Stage.
notes.content:
Release Announcement for "Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball."

We’re excited to announce that Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball. will be released on March 27, 2028(PDT)

To celebrate the launch, the game will be available at a 40% discount. We encourage you to come and get knocked out—in the most enthusiastic sense possible.

If you manage to defeat the EX Boss, please let us know! A video URL is required—we’ll be watching.

A word of caution: if you're using a subpar mouse, this game may prove quite challenging.
The core concept revolves around swinging with full force, and we completely overlooked the fact that this assumes a high-quality mouse capable of detecting rapid motion.
In particular, low-DPI mice may not respond as intended.

If you run into trouble, try heading to the Mouse Boost Settings from the title screen and crank up the sensitivity.
If that still doesn’t help… consider making a device investment (a better mouse, preferably a gaming one).

For bug reports or other inquiries, please contact us at the support address below.
